info.name: HPIS Alarm Push API - Fresh Environment
info.description: 覆盖 Alarm、Push、企业微信资源、候选负责人和工单闭环。配置数据全部通过 API 增删改查；SQL 仅用于只读证据核验。请仅在专用测试租户使用，并在本地填写 Secret/Token 后禁止导出真实值。

request.description: /configure/add 创建报警配置。必填：alarmConfigureName、alarmType、deviceAlarmControl、alarmConfigurePeriod、sceneType、deviceIds；本用例还必须设置 pushEnabled、pushMessageType、workorderPushMessageType、workorderConfigId。
/configure/add 创建普通报警负向配置。必填：alarmConfigureName、alarmType、deviceAlarmControl、alarmConfigurePeriod、sceneType、deviceIds、pushEnabled、pushMessageType；本用例不使用工单字段，也不使用 SQL 写配置。

item.name: 02 - WeCom App Binding and Recipient Group
item.description: 只在专用测试租户执行。企业微信应用没有 DELETE 接口；测试结束通过 PUT enabled=false。Secret 不得保存到导出的结果文件。

item.name: Create or update tenant WeCom app

exec: pm.test('wecom app saved without secret echo', () => { pm.expect(responseData.enabled).to.eql(true); pm.expect(responseData.secretConfigured).to.eql(true); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(responseData)).not.to.include(pm.environment.get('wecomCorpSecret')); });

pm.test('two enabled bindings exist', () => { pm.expect(rows.some(x => String(x.userId) === pm.environment.get('userId') && x.enabled === true)).to.be.true; pm.expect(rows.some(x => String(x.userId) === pm.environment.get('secondUserId') && x.enabled === true)).to.be.true; });
const exactGroupId = groupIdStart >= '"groupId":'.length ? rawResponse.substring(groupIdStart, rawResponse.indexOf(',', groupIdStart)) : '';

pm.test('group update and member de-duplication persisted', () => { pm.expect(responseData.groupName).to.eql('api-push-e2e-group-updated-' + pm.environment.get('runId')); pm.expect(responseData.userIds).to.have.lengthOf(2); });

request.description: /pushConfig/add 必填：messageType、pushChannelType、enabled、pushAddress、isPassive、configName、deviceSns。pushAddress 不得包含 http://，当前 PushHttpConsumer 会自行补充协议。
/pushConfig/add 创建工单推送配置。必填：messageType、pushChannelType、enabled、pushAddress、isPassive、configName、deviceSns；messageType=25，HTTP 接收器端口 19025，pushAddress 不带协议。

exec: const exactConfigId = name => { const nameIndex = rawResponse.indexOf('"configName":"' + name + '"'); if (nameIndex < 0) return ''; const prefix = rawResponse.substring(0, nameIndex); const idIndex = prefix.lastIndexOf('"activePushConfigId":'); if (idIndex < 0) return ''; const valueStart = idIndex + '"activePushConfigId":'.length; return rawResponse.substring(valueStart, rawResponse.indexOf(',', valueStart)); };
pm.test('HTTP and WeCom 10/25 configs exist', () => { pm.expect(config10).to.exist; pm.expect(config25).to.exist; pm.expect(wecom10).to.exist; pm.expect(wecom25).to.exist; });

request.description: 通过 /pushConfig/{id} 查询 API 创建后的 25 完整配置，确认 messageType、enabled、pushAddress 和 deviceSns。

exec: pm.test('candidate users are unique and reachable', () => { pm.expect(rows.filter(x => String(x.userId) === pm.environment.get('userId'))).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(rows.some(x => String(x.userId) === pm.environment.get('userId') && x.wecomReachable === true)).to.be.true; pm.expect(rows.some(x => String(x.userId) === pm.environment.get('secondUserId') && x.wecomReachable === true)).to.be.true; });

item.name: Case 1 - Create emergency alarm device A
Verify device A arrived at receiver 10

exec: pm.test('device A messageType 10 received', () => pm.expect(events.some(e => (e.rawBody || JSON.stringify(e.body || {})).includes('"messageType":"10"') && (e.rawBody || JSON.stringify(e.body || {})).includes('"deviceSn":"' + pm.environment.get('deviceASn') + '"'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Case 2 - Create emergency alarm device B
Verify device B arrived at receiver 10

exec: pm.test('device B messageType 10 received', () => pm.expect(events.some(e => (e.rawBody || JSON.stringify(e.body || {})).includes('"messageType":"10"') && (e.rawBody || JSON.stringify(e.body || {})).includes('"deviceSn":"' + pm.environment.get('deviceBSn') + '"'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Case 3 - Create normal alarm negative control
Verify normal alarm did not enter receiver 10

exec: pm.test('normal alarm excluded from receiver 10', () => pm.expect(events.some(e => (e.rawBody || JSON.stringify(e.body || {})).includes('"deviceSn":"' + pm.environment.get('normalDeviceSn') + '"'))).to.be.false);

item.name: Create emergency alarm for abnormal close
Capture three internal alarm IDs through API

exec: const exactAlarmId = cid => { const cidIndex = rawResponse.indexOf('"alarmCid":"' + cid + '"'); if (cidIndex < 0) return ''; const prefix = rawResponse.substring(0, cidIndex); const idIndex = prefix.lastIndexOf('"alarmId":'); if (idIndex < 0) return ''; const valueStart = idIndex + '"alarmId":'.length; return rawResponse.substring(valueStart, rawResponse.indexOf(',', valueStart)).replace(/"/g, '').trim(); };
pm.test('three alarm IDs resolved by exact CID in response', () => { pm.expect(assigned).to.exist; pm.expect(unassigned).to.exist; pm.expect(closeAlarm).to.exist; });

item.name: 05 - Workorder Ownership Lifecycle
item.description: 使用三条不同报警验证具体负责人、未分配后转派和异常关闭。完成请求必须由负责人 Token 发起；企业微信客户端实收不作为本轮自动断言。

body.raw:
{
  "alarmId": {{internalAlarmId}},
  "title": "API Push assigned workorder",
  "content": "owned by primary user",
  "assigneeId": {{userId}},
  "assigneeName": "api-push-primary"
}

exec: pm.test('created event carries primary assignee', () => pm.expect(events.some(e => e.body && e.body.messageType === '25' && e.body.data && e.body.data.eventType === 'ALARM_WORKORDER_CREATED' && String(e.body.assigneeId) === pm.environment.get('userId'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Capture assigned workorder from all list
Primary user sees assigned workorder in my list

exec: pm.test('my list contains owned workorder', () => pm.expect(rows.some(x => String(x.workorderId) === pm.environment.get('workorderId'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Other tenant cannot read assigned workorder

exec: pm.test('cross-tenant detail is invisible', () => { const crossTenantDetail = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(crossTenantDetail.code !== 200 || !crossTenantDetail.data).to.be.true; });

item.name: Other tenant cannot transfer assigned workorder
Edit assigned workorder title and content

request.description: status、tenantId、assigneeId 是越界字段，服务必须忽略；只允许 title/content 生效。

item.name: Read edit and verify protected fields unchanged

exec: pm.test('only editable fields changed', () => { pm.expect(responseData.title).to.eql('API Push assigned workorder updated'); pm.expect(responseData.status).to.eql('0'); pm.expect(String(responseData.assigneeId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('userId')); pm.expect(String(responseData.tenantId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('tenantId')); });

item.name: Transfer assigned workorder to second user
Verify transfer reached HTTP 25 for new assignee

exec: pm.test('transferred event carries only new assignee target', () => pm.expect(events.some(e => { const raw = e.rawBody || JSON.stringify(e.body || {}); return raw.includes('"messageType":"25"') && raw.includes('"eventType":"ALARM_WORKORDER_TRANSFERRED"') && raw.includes('"assigneeId":' + pm.environment.get('secondUserId')); })).to.be.true);

item.name: Old owner cannot complete after transfer

exec: pm.test('completion result and picture returned', () => { pm.expect(responseData.status).to.eql('2'); pm.expect(responseData.handleResult).to.eql('assigned completed ' + pm.environment.get('runId')); pm.expect(responseData.handlePicture).to.eql('/test/' + pm.environment.get('runId') + '/assigned-complete.jpg'); });

item.name: Unassigned workorder is absent from my list

exec: pm.test('unassigned is not owned by current user', () => pm.expect(rows.some(x => String(x.workorderId) === pm.environment.get('unassignedWorkorderId'))).to.be.false);

item.name: Transfer unassigned workorder to second user
Second owner completes formerly unassigned workorder

request.description: 禁用后使用新的已确认报警创建工单；alarm 仍发送 25，但不能回退到 10/22。update 必须带完整对象。
/pushConfig/update 恢复 25 路由。update 额外必填 activePushConfigId，且必须携带 messageType、pushChannelType、enabled、pushAddress、isPassive、configName、deviceSns 完整对象。
使用新的已确认报警建单，随后用 check.sql 验证工单已提交且 push_message_log 留下失败记录。
/pushConfig/update 将不可达地址恢复为 19025。必须发送含 activePushConfigId 的完整对象，避免测试结束时配置停留在失败地址。

item.name: Case 8 - Set workorderPushMessageType null through API

request.description: /configure/update 额外必填 alarmConfigureId，并必须携带完整对象。传 null 后用详情/API 证据确认是否真正置空；当前动态更新会忽略 null，本用例用于暴露该能力门禁，不能误报通过。
/configure/update 恢复工单推送类型为 25。update 额外必填 alarmConfigureId，并发送名称、报警类型、开关、时段、场景、设备、push 类型和模板 ID 的完整对象。
